claim_ceiling: All 5 factory direction v29 deliverables addressed at maximum available scale (22-year / 144,443 decisions). Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at all scales (JP max 0.4265). Linear hybrids PASS at 19/22yr but remain below TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.67 vs 0.79). Citation heritage recovery by dense embeddings (AUC 0.79-0.85) is validated but does not translate to jurist gate pass. Legal TF-IDF from published corpus fails transfer. Blocker is upstream data dependency (missing 2022-2026 parquet, no bge_<->bger_ mapping). No further same-question cycles justified.
